title: Cernly map (map.json) v1
description: Derived from one facts file by the rules (https://cernly.dev/how/map/). Deterministic: same facts + same rules version + same settings = byte-identical file, canonical JSON like the scan. Every derived item names the fact keys it comes from in `from`; the evidence (file + line) is in those facts, the map adds none of its own. Draft, like scan v1.

scan.description: The facts file this map was derived from

sha256.description: Of the facts file bytes as read

catalogue_version.description: Version of the provider catalogue the rules used (https://cernly.dev/how/catalogue/)

confirmations.description: Confirmations in effect when the map was derived (https://cernly.dev/how/stacks/), in id order

derived_role.description: What the rules derived, when a declaration replaced it

manual.description: A workflow_dispatch path starts this stack

reasons.description: One verdict per workflow job that starts the stack; the stack takes the strongest

unreadable.description: if: terms the rules cannot read, as normalised

test_job.description: The job is a test job, so it never makes the stack production (https://cernly.dev/how/stacks/)

contexts.description: Build contexts the link was built with; empty when none is known, and then sources is empty too

sources.description: Repo paths: the recipe's sources inside each context

ci_images.description: Images a CI job builds that no Compose service of the repo runs (https://cernly.dev/how/map/). One per recipe (Dockerfile and stage). Never production: where it runs is not in this repo. Optional: maps from rules before 0.3.0 lack it.

image.description: ci_image:<dockerfile>:<stage>; the subject of attached[] and parties[].services

target.description: The stage built: the named target, or the final stage's name

image_repos.description: image_repo of every build, as written

builds.description: Every CI job that builds it

line.description: The step that builds it, or reaches the script that does

test_job.description: The job is a test job (applied to the steps after the build, https://cernly.dev/how/stacks/)

pushes.description: Registry repositories it is pushed to, as written, tag stripped; empty when no push is seen

by.description: push: the build command pushes all its tags (image_build push); docker_push: a later step of the same job

sources.description: Repo paths: the recipe's sources inside each context, as for links

test_only.description: Every CI job that builds it is a test job; kept and marked, never hidden

deployment.description: not_seen: nothing in this repo shows where it runs

detail.description: The image in words, as the app and the report show it

attached.description: Facts that live in a linked service's code, or an image built in CI (service is then its ci_image key): dependency, env_var, outbound_host whose evidence lies in a link source. Nothing filtered; scope as the fact has it.

scope.description: The fact's own scope (prod, dev, test, build, unknown), when it has one

internal.description: Repo folder, when the dependency is an internal package (https://cernly.dev/how/facts/)

source.description: The link source the evidence lies in

parties.description: Outside parties from the provider catalogue (https://cernly.dev/how/catalogue/). A party is on a service when one of its matching facts is attached to that service.

kind.description: protocol: names no provider (S3 API, SMTP)

grade.description: confirmed: two or more signal kinds agree; single: one kind

services.description: Service and data store keys; empty when only facts on no service match

internal.description: Protocols served by a data store in the same stack (S3 by MinIO): left off the outside parties

unknown.description: Host hints no catalogue entry claims: the unknown bucket. AI naming comes later and stays suggested until a human confirms.

usage.description: Strongest way it was seen; a mention is a literal not shown to be called

confirmed.description: Approved as a supplier in the application

own.description: The organisation's own hosts: on a declared own domain, or served by a route of the repo (https://cernly.dev/how/plugins/), or both. Never an outside party, never unknown

domain.description: The declared domain, or the host itself when it is only served

confirmed.description: Claimed as own in the application, as domains.own

served_by.description: route facts whose site address is this host

routes.description: Web server routes (route facts) placed in the stack whose service mounts the config file. An upstream that names a service or data store of that stack is an edge (to); any other upstream stays as written. One entry per route, mounting service and upstream

stack.description: Absent: no compose service mounts the file

via.description: The service that mounts the file

match.description: Methods and paths, a named matcher, or * for everything

ai_tools.description: AI coding tools the repo is set up for (agent_config facts): repo-level proof, not which change a tool wrote

subject.description: Fact key the finding is about

grade.description: image_pinning: how the image is pinned (https://cernly.dev/how/facts/); exact means a full version without digest

image.description: image_pinning: the image repository without tag (registry/repository), so a new tag of the same repository reads as an upgrade (https://cernly.dev/how/gate/)

tests.description: Test suites per service and the commands that run them (https://cernly.dev/how/plugins/): a test_suite whose folders lie in a link's sources is on that service; a test_run of the suite's language covers it in its own folder (maven, gradle and pytest also in the folders below). No coverage is measured. Absent without test_suite facts

service.description: Service fact key; absent when the suite lies on no linked service

runs.description: test_run keys; empty when no command found runs the suite

jobs.description: CI jobs that reach one of the runs

tables.description: Database tables merged across schema sources by qualified name, with columns whose name looks sensitive (https://cernly.dev/how/map/). Absent without db_table facts

table.description: Qualified name as the facts give it

schema.description: The part before the last dot; absent when the name has none

from.description: db_table fact keys, one per source

check.description: Columns whose name matches the fixed word list: check encryption and access, not a verdict

word.description: The word list entry that matched

confirmations.description: What each confirmation in settings did to this map (https://cernly.dev/how/stacks/). Absent without confirmations

status.description: overridden: a declaration in the scan wins; no_subject: this scan has no such stack, party or host

dismissed.description: Parties and hosts a person said are not suppliers (https://cernly.dev/how/stacks/): moved here from parties and unknown, so they stay visible

modules.description: The import graph of the repo's own packages (rules 0.8.0, https://cernly.dev/how/map/): import facts as edges, the packages they name as nodes. Absent without import facts.

fan_in.description: Packages of the repo that import it

fan_out.description: Packages of the repo it imports

depth.description: Longest chain of imports below it; a cycle counts as one step

lines.description: Import lines that prove the edge

services.description: The packages each linked service or image built in CI reaches: from its recipe's resolved Go entrypoints, else every package in its sources

metrics.description: Surface metrics (rules 0.8.0; items since 0.10.0, https://cernly.dev/how/map/), counted from this map: in total, in the stacks whose role is production or production (unconfirmed), and per service. Size and coupling are context, never the headline. Absent in maps of rules before 0.8.0.

service.description: A service key or a ci_image key

role.description: Its stack's role; none for an image built in CI

data_stores.description: Data stores of its stack it depends on

columns_to_check.description: Columns to check of tables whose schema lies in its sources

unpinned_images.description: image_pinning findings on it or its recipe

items.description: What each count counts (rules 0.10.0); each list as long as its count. Absent before rules 0.10.0

service_items.description: What a service's counts count (rules 0.10.0), so every number traces to its facts. Absent before rules 0.10.0

outside_parties.description: Party ids; each party lists its signal facts

columns_to_check.description: table.column; the table lists its facts

size.description: Source files and physical lines from source_size facts; a file counts once. test_files and test_lines count the test code among them again, on their own

test_job.description: A test job (https://cernly.dev/how/stacks/). Evidence: the workflow file at line

by.description: What matched: a name, or only test runners after the stack starts or the image is built

match.description: The name, or the first test runner command, as written

line.description: Line of the job or step in the workflow file

declarant.description: Who declared it (https://cernly.dev/how/config/): the repo's hint file (.cernly.yml) or the operator

confirmation.description: A decision a person made in the application (https://cernly.dev/how/stacks/), never a fact. Declarations in the scan win over it

id.description: The entry in the instance's trail

subject.description: A stack key, party:<id>, host:<host>, or for driver a dependency key

value.description: stack_role: production or none; party: approved or not_supplier; host: approved, not_supplier or own; driver: store:<the store it talks to, as a person names it> or not_used

person.description: The sign-in provider's subject for the person

overridden.description: A declaration in the scan says otherwise, and wins
